task.title: e2e suite never tears down soft-deleted collections
task.description: Isolated during WB-01M0DSYZDJ verification (2026-08-19): the suite has no teardown for soft-deleted collections, and three distinct pre-existing failure modes trace to that one fact: (1) the Inbox has accumulated 159 copies of a card a test expects 2 of; (2) /my/recently-deleted is LIMIT 50 and permanently full, so a test's subject falls out of the window mid-test (oldest row only minutes old); (3) the tree carries 137 leftover zz-e2e collections out of 146 live, turning tree-walk tests (responsive.spec.ts:430) into ~137 page loads until timeout. Fix shape: a teardown/reaper for zz-e2e-prefixed collections (and their soft-deleted remains), or a purge step in the fixture. Distinct from the fixture-pool task WB-01KZMVA2Y1 and the contention tasks WB-01KZRZ0TT7/WB-01KZNPJC9S, though it inflates the same baseline.
